design_philosophy.core: Objective, function-first interface built for fast-paced warehouse environments. High legibility, large touch targets, and strict color-coding for rapid cognitive recognition.
design_philosophy.accessibility: Minimum 48px touch targets for gloved hands. High contrast text (APCA/WCAG compliant) for poor warehouse lighting.

blue_order_stores.usage: Pedir flow, Lojas screen, primary action buttons

green_receive_categories.usage: Receber flow, Categorias screen, success states, Received tags

orange_cart.usage: Carrinho, Em via tags, pending states

buttons.primary: Solid background (Flow Color), inverse white text, min-height 56px, rounded-lg, strong font-bold
buttons.secondary: Soft background (Flow Color bg_soft), Flow Color text, min-height 56px, rounded-lg
buttons.action_card: Large square or wide rectangular touchable card. Background card color, 2px bottom shadow, icon left, title right. Border color matches flow.

inputs.text: Background input color, 1px strong border, min-height 56px, 16px font size, placeholder text secondary
inputs.checkbox: 24x24px minimum size, 4px radius, active state uses purple_products.primary

lists.item: Row layout, Flex between, padding 16px, 1px bottom border light. Large touch area.
lists.quantity_control: Row with [-] [Count] [+]. Buttons 40x40px, count text 16px bold min-width 32px center aligned.

status_tags.em_estoque: bg_soft green, text green, small uppercase label
status_tags.em_via: bg_soft orange, text orange, small uppercase label
status_tags.recebido: solid green, text inverse, small uppercase label

1_login.layout: Centered form, 16px padding. App Logo/Title (Estoque). Phone Input, Password Input. Primary Button (Entrar - Blue).

2_home.content: 2 Massive Action Cards taking 50% height each or full width blocks. 'PEDIR' (Blue accent), 'RECEBER' (Green accent).

3_lojas.header: Title 'Lojas', Blue theme. Stack Navigation Back button.
3_lojas.list: Castelo, Mesc, Delivery, Baeta, Produção. Full width rows with right chevron.

4_categorias.header: Title 'Categorias' or 'Setores'. Green theme (from Receber flow) or Blue (from Pedir).
4_categorias.list: Secos, Geladeira, Limpeza, Embalagens. Grid 2x2 or thick list.

5_listas_produtos.header: Purple theme. Title based on Category.
5_listas_produtos.list_type_a_inventory: Shows product name and current stock tag (e.g. 15 unid).
5_listas_produtos.list_type_b_selection: Checkbox left, Product Name center, Quantity controller right ([-][1][+]).

6_carrinho.content: List of selected items. Total count.
6_carrinho.action: Massive 'CONFIRMAR PEDIDO' button at bottom (Orange). Sets status to 'em via!'

7_receber_flow.content: List of 'em via!' orders. Tap to confirm reception. Confirmed items show 'recebido'.

login_background.description: Clean geometric mobile app background for login screen

empty_state_box.description: Minimalist high-contrast vector of a warehouse delivery box for empty states

instructions_to_main_agent: Use standard React Native components (View, Text, TouchableOpacity, ScrollView) combined with Tailwind (NativeWind) or StyleSheet.
Do NOT use web-only HTML tags (div, span) since this is an Expo mobile app.
Ensure all interactive elements use TouchableOpacity or Pressable with clear visual feedback.
Apply test IDs to all buttons and inputs (e.g., testID='login-button', testID='product-item-2').
Use safe area insets (SafeAreaView) to prevent content from going under the notch or status bar.
Use Lucide-React-Native for icons, matching the flow color strictly (Blue/Green/Purple/Orange).
